'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Northern Kharkiv Oblast front of the Russo-Ukrainian war|2024 Kharkiv offensive]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] states that its forces have captured several villages in [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/05/12/europe/russia-kharkiv-region-offensive-ukraine-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[May 2024 Belgorod bombing|May 2024 Belgorod missile strike]]
***At least 17 civilians are killed and 30 others are injured when a missile hit an apartment block in [[Belgorod]], [[Russia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-belgorod-shelling-building-collapse-259b543bb479bea475051850e0b8fd2a (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-shelling-kills-least-three-russian-apartment-block-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[President of Russia]] [[Vladimir Putin]] reassigns [[Minister of Defence (Russia)|Defence Minister]] [[Sergei Shoigu]] to the [[Security Council of Russia|National Security Council]] and replaces him with [[First Deputy Prime Minister of Russia|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Andrey Belousov]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/05/12/defense-minister-shoigu-ousted-russia/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]	
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]	
***[[Rafah offensive]]	
****[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] warns [[Israel]] lacks a credible plan to protect Rafah civilians. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/israel-lacks-credible-plan-safeguard-rafah-civilians-says-blinken-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Siege of El Fasher|Battle of El Fasher]]
***Fighting during [[Rapid Support Forces|RSF]] attacks on eastern [[El Fasher]], over the weekend, kill at least 38 civilians and injure 189 others amid fears of an all out RSF assault on the city. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/05/12/sudan-war-rsf-el-fashir/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Afghanistan–Pakistan floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing [[flood]]ing in northern [[Afghanistan]] increases to 315, with more than 1,600 people injured, and more than 1,000 houses destroyed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-ministry-death-toll-floods-northern-afghanistan-rises-315-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing flooding in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 143, with 125 people still missing. The Brazilian government has announced [[Brazilian real|R$]]12.1 billion in emergency spending in response to the crisis. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-rains-brazils-south-reaches-143-govt-announces-emergency-spending-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*The Marywilska 44 [[shopping mall]] in [[Białołęka]] district, [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]], is destroyed in a suspected arson attack. Many of the venues were Vietnamese-owned. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/vietnamese-vendors-suffer-great-losses-in-warsaw-shopping-complex-fire/articleshow/110083846.cms (''The Times of India'')] [https://www.pb.pl/splonelo-centrum-handlowe-marywilska-44-1215460 (Puls Biznesu)]
*Wildfires in [[British Columbia]] and [[Alberta]], [[Canada]], force thousands to evacuate. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/05/12/us/wildfire-smoke-from-british-columbia-causing-dangerous-air-quality/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Egypt–Israel relations]], [[Rafah offensive]]
**[[Egypt]] announces it will intervene on [[South Africa]]'s side in the ''[[South Africa's genocide case against Israel|South Africa v Israel]]'' case in response to [[Israel]]'s growing assault on [[Rafah]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/egypt-intervene-icj-case-israel-tensions-rise-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Catalan regional election]]
**The [[Socialists' Party of Catalonia]] wins the regional election with its best result since 2003. Pro-independence parties lose their absolute majority in the [[Parliament of Catalonia|Parliament]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/catalans-vote-election-that-offers-new-chance-exiled-separatist-leader-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Lithuanian presidential election]], [[2024 Lithuanian constitutional referendum]]
**Lithuanians elect the [[President of Lithuania]] and vote on a constitutional amendment that would allow [[dual citizenship]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory/lithuanians-vote-presidential-election-anxieties-rise-russia-war-110141236 (ABC News)] [https://lnk.lt/straipsniai/politika/prezidento-rinkimuose-referendume-toliau-balsuojama-vos-aktyviau-nei-pries-penkmeti/251112 (lnk.lt)]
*[[2024 North Macedonian presidential election]]
**[[Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova]] is sworn in as the first female [[President of North Macedonia]]. [https://mk.bloombergadria.com/drugo/politika/58336/gordana-siljanovska-davkova-oficijalno-e-novata-pretsedatelka-na-makedonija/news/ (Bloomberg Macedonia)]
*Forty-nine [[Vatican Museums]] employees start an unprecedented labor dispute over unfair and poor working conditions against [[Vatican City|the Vatican]]'s [[Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State|Pontifical Commission]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/vatican-museums-staff-start-unprecedented-legal-action-over-labour-conditions-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*Hundreds of protesters march in [[Tunis]], [[Tunisia]], to demand the release of imprisoned journalists, activists, and opposition figures. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/hundreds-protest-tunisia-demand-date-fair-presidential-elections-2024-05-12/ (Reuters)]
